ownership.quote: Hyperbrowser.ai is the internet infrastructure for AI agents. We provide instant, scalable browser infra with built-in CAPTCHA solving, proxy management, and anti-bot detection.

stage.note: At least pre-seed: went through Y Combinator (Summer 2021), which invests in every company it takes; no later round found.

note: Confirmed as a Y Combinator company: YC directory lists Hyperbrowser, batch S21 (Summer 2021), status Active, website https://hyperbrowser.ai (same domain as the card's https://www.hyperbrowser.ai/pricing) and founders Shri Sukhani (ex-Meta) and Akshay Shekhawat. Product is 'Web infra for AI agents' (browser-as-a-service, HyperAgent, MCP server), actively launching features through 2025 per YC Launch posts and Hacker News Show HN posts. No funding round, investor names, or revenue figures were found in the YC page, company site/blog, Hacker News threads, or third-party aggregator sites (Crunchbase and several search engines blocked automated access; Growjo/GetLatka/PitchBook/Tracxn pages had no visible funding data) within the ~15-minute research window, so funding stage, amount, and revenue are left unknown rather than guessed.
